quarterly_data.signal: TeLuRide-006 first interim analysis (Q2 2026 results release): on August 11, 2026 Eikon reported that the first interim analysis of TeLuRide-006 (NCT06697301), its ongoing global Phase 2/3 registrational trial of EIK1001 with pembrolizumab in first-line advanced melanoma, was completed by an independent Data Monitoring Committee (DMC). The DMC selected, per protocol, a single dosing regimen for expansion of the trial and recommended that the study continue as planned.
quarterly_data.figure: first interim analysis completed August 11, 2026; single dosing regimen selected; study to continue as planned

quarterly_data.signal: ASCO 2026 data for EIK1001 (presented May 30, 2026, per the Q2 2026 results release): updated data from TeLuRide-005 (NCT06246110), the ongoing open-label Phase 2 trial of EIK1001 with pembrolizumab and histology-appropriate chemotherapy in NSCLC, showed what Eikon calls encouraging activity in front-line advanced NSCLC - meaningful and consistent clinical activity across PD-(L)1 tumor proportion score subgroups, EIK1001 generally well tolerated (permitting outpatient administration), and durable anti-tumor activity with a median response duration of greater than 11 months in the non-squamous cohort. Eikon believes its data to date show intravenous EIK1001 has been generally well-tolerated, activates readily measured systemic immune responses and can be combined with current standard of care.
quarterly_data.figure: median response duration greater than 11 months (non-squamous cohort)

quarterly_data.signal: ASCO 2026 data for EIK1003 (presented May 30, 2026): from the ongoing Phase 1/2 trial (NCT06253130), Eikon presented updated safety, tolerability and preliminary efficacy data from monotherapy Cohort 1A (ovarian, breast, prostate and pancreatic cancers) and initial data from Cohort 1C (EIK1003 plus paclitaxel in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer, or breast cancer that is either HER2-negative, ER-positive and hormonal therapy-experienced, or ER-negative and chemotherapy-experienced), which the company says gave preliminary evidence that the PARP1-selective inhibitor EIK1003 could be safely combined with full-dose paclitaxel in second-line treatment of breast and ovarian cancers.

ESMO Congress 2026 (Madrid): Eikon announced seven abstracts accepted for presentation, related to all four of its current clinical candidates. EIK1001: comprehensive updated / full combination data from the TeLuRide-005 NSCLC trial on Monday, October 26. EIK1003: updated data from Cohorts 1A and 1C plus initial data from Cohort 1B (EIK1003 with abiraterone and prednisone in advanced prostate cancer) on Friday, October 23. EIK1004: first data from its Phase 1/2 trial (NCT06907043) in ovarian, breast, prostate and pancreatic cancers on October 23. EIK1005: preliminary safety, tolerability and pharmacokinetic data from its Phase 1/2 trial (NCT07262619) on October 23. CEO Roger Perlmutter said the new results expand what Eikon reported at ASCO in June.
quarterly_data.figure: seven ESMO 2026 abstracts; EIK1003, EIK1004 and EIK1005 data October 23; TeLuRide-005 data October 26
